items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: With all the guys like Roy, what's your name, on piano, and Shorty Reese on tenor, and Frank Federico, and all of them.

ctx.x: Oh, you got Hatter Call highlights.
Remember Hatter Call? Yeah, yeah, highlights. There you go. Mickey Rooney. Sharky. Roy Acuff.
